rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Every square has a name: the letter of its file, from a to h, and the number of its rank, from 1 to 8.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: A file runs from top to bottom; a rank, from side to side. The rook is on d4.
rot.ideia.ex1.e4: It moves in a straight line: up, down and sideways.
rot.ideia.ex1.e5: In a single move it can go as many squares as it likes, as long as the way is clear.
rot.ideia.ex1.e6: A tip: when I mention a square, like d8, click on it and I will show it on the board.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Take the rook to d8 in a single move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The rook went up four squares at once.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes up the d-file to d8, all at once.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: The rook stopped on another square. Let's go back: the target is d8, at the top of its file.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Take the rook to d8 in a single move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: It could have stopped on any square along the way: d5, d6 or d7.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: From d4 the rook reaches fourteen squares: the whole d-file and the whole fourth rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.l3: Sideways works the same way: it runs along the rank to h4.
rot.ideia.ex1.l4: And it goes down the h-file to the corner.
rot.ideia.ex1.l5: Each move follows a single line. To change direction, the rook needs another move.
rot.ideia.ex1.l6: Remember the idea: the rook moves in a straight line, as many squares as it likes.
rot.ideia.ex1.l7: Now let's see what happens when a piece is in the way.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now there is a white pawn on c6, on the rook's file.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The rook does not jump over pieces: the pawn blocks its way up the c-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: It can go up to c5, just below the pawn, and stop there.
rot.ideia.ex2.e4: Nor can it stop on c6: the square already holds a piece from its own side.
rot.ideia.ex2.e5: Your goal is to take the rook to c8, on the other side of the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: What is the rook's first move towards c8? Suggest one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The rook leaves the c-file, which the pawn blocks.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The shortest route starts by leaving the c-file: the rook goes to d1.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1a1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the a-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1a1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1b1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the b-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1b1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1e1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the e-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1e1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1f1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the f-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1f1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1g1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the g-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1g1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1h1.1: That works too! Leaving along the first rank, the rook goes around the pawn via the h-file.
rot.ideia.ex2.alt.c1h1.2: Let's continue via the d-file, which leads to the same place.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c2.1: Going up the c-file, the rook gets close to the pawn, but it is still in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c2.2: To reach c8, it would still have to leave the file. Let's go back and look for the shortest route.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c3.1: Going up the c-file, the rook gets close to the pawn, but it is still in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c3.2: To reach c8, it would still have to leave the file. Let's go back and look for the shortest route.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c4.1: Going up the c-file, the rook gets close to the pawn, but it is still in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c4.2: To reach c8, it would still have to leave the file. Let's go back and look for the shortest route.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c5.1: Going up the c-file, the rook gets close to the pawn, but it is still in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c1c5.2: To reach c8, it would still have to leave the file. Let's go back and look for the shortest route.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not take the rook towards c8. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: What is the rook's first move towards c8? Suggest one, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Now the d-file is clear: the rook goes up to d8.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: And it moves along the eighth rank to c8.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Three moves to get around the pawn: the rook does not jump, it goes around.
rot.ideia.ex2.l4: And what if the rook went up the c-file first?
rot.ideia.ex2.l5: It gets to c5, but the pawn is still in front of it.
rot.ideia.ex2.l6: It would still need three moves to go around. Leaving the c-file at once is faster.
rot.ideia.ex2.l7: Remember the idea: if a piece blocks the line, the rook looks for another clear line.
rot.ideia.ex2.l8: You have now seen the rook's two rules: straight lines and a clear path. Now I will show them in other positions.
rot.demos.cantoACanto.e1: Look at the rook in the corner, on h8.
rot.demos.cantoACanto.e2: It will go to the opposite corner, a1, in just two moves.
rot.demos.cantoACanto.l1: First it crosses the whole eighth rank, to a8.
rot.demos.cantoACanto.l2: Then it goes down the a-file to a1.
rot.demos.cantoACanto.l3: With a clear path, one rook move crosses the board.
rot.demos.cercada.e1: Now the rook is surrounded by white pawns.
rot.demos.cercada.e2: Notice where it can still go.
rot.demos.cercada.l1: Only to four squares: d5, e4, c4 and d3. The pawns block all the others.
rot.demos.cercada.l2: It goes up to d5 and stops: right above is a pawn of its own colour.
rot.demos.cercada.l3: The clearer the lines, the more squares the rook reaches.
rot.demos.contorno.e1: The rook on h1 wants to reach h8, but the pawn on h5 blocks the file.
rot.demos.contorno.l1: It leaves the h-file and goes to g1.
rot.demos.contorno.l2: It goes up the g-file, which is clear.
rot.demos.contorno.l3: And it takes one step sideways, to h8.
rot.demos.contorno.l4: There is always a way: leave the blocked line, travel along a clear one and only then go to the target.
rot.demos.contorno.l5: Now it's your turn: take the rook to the stars.
rot.pratica.estrelas1.enunciado: Take the rook to the three stars, in any order you like.
rot.pratica.estrelas1.fim: Perfect. Did you see how it crosses the board in a single move?
rot.pratica.estrelas2.enunciado: Now the pawn on f6 is in the way. Take the rook to the stars.
rot.pratica.estrelas2.fim: Well done. You now know how to move the rook: straight lines, a clear path and, if something blocks the way, a detour.
